title: Reconcile Marine Agar 2216 dry-product components and unsupported hydrate reference
body:
Marine_agar_2216.yaml mixes a dry commercial-product interpretation with an eighteen-part prepared formulation including water and a COMPLETE component assertion. TOGO M2265 distinguishes 55.1 g dry product from separately added water and gives a seventeen-ingredient dry-base table. The retained magnesium-chloride component points to CHEBI:86345 (hexahydrate) although the inspected product table only names magnesium chloride.

Exact reviewed scope:
- Finding `MEDIA-SCI-05`; stable key `w04-independent-MEDIA-SCI-05`; immutable peer review `20261108T070033Z-w04-successor-science-v1`.
- `media-alias-marine2216`; owner `data/ingredients/mapped/Marine_agar_2216.yaml`; before `7b9ca92398062ef3901dc2aabcbd3f2bae57d64f60fd34ddd450d833be607baf`; proposed SHA256 `1b07179588f4d24497a5a46ce1aef35fabb43acd50347a3c726c154c9ecca063`.
  [Exact published proposal](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/548e7bdd0ce2a68b3ae0df6ad7a6150a4e5c9bb9/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-04/proposals/media/Marine_agar_2216.yaml).

Establish the authentic intended whole-owner scope and reconcile the component assertion to it, retaining distinct prepared-medium evidence. Inspect whether the historical ATCC scratch formulation is a prepared medium before changing water membership; do not blindly remove water. Preserve the source’s literal unresolved salt form unless hydration is established. Keep the supported Marine Agar aliases, history, quantities and separate recipe variants. No product identity or component hydration may be guessed.

Evidence:

- [Primary/ontology source](https://togomedium.org/sparqlist/api/gmdb_medium_by_gmid?gm_id=M2265); capture SHA256 `71c6746e70ee6e148de998d8ba8d751dac8f95eae4d6aca615e6fa2e5abdafc5`; M2265 main powder55.1g+DIwater1000mL; dedicated dry-base component table
- [Primary/ontology source](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/api/ontologies/chebi/terms?iri=http%3A%2F%2Fpurl.obolibrary.org%2Fobo%2FCHEBI_86345); capture SHA256 `cdf62749dcbfbfaa3b7d424c018306977fd107a3387f104f7f1a1bfa00b9adf7`; Definition and formula explicitly MgCl2 hexahydrate
- [Primary/ontology source](https://www.dsmz.de/microorganisms/medium/pdf/DSMZ_Medium604.pdf); capture SHA256 `9ebc39cf6780c73b02ed0bdb09b3d83d89d3d2813c2853b99b7a7974c64d8a24`; Prepared Marine2216(Difco0979) source context

Deduplication: #1208 is the distinct Marine_Broth_2216.yaml formula defect (broth versus agar magnesium salt/quantity); link it but do not close it through this agar repair. #917 is a skill example/import issue, not a scientific formulation decision.

Review context: W04 published head `548e7bdd0ce2a68b3ae0df6ad7a6150a4e5c9bb9`, frozen campaign base `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99`. Main as observed at `0dac278466699129a083343a921c2e0ca18a9ab4` has the same eighteen affected inherited-owner blobs as the frozen baseline; this is not a report of already-applied campaign curation. The full independent assembly covers 188 source cases and 115 proposals and remains `needs_curation`. Original peer review and evidence are immutable.
